items.title: Inside the Owls’ Burrow S11, E13
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Inside the Owls' Burrow, the official weekly television show for Florida Atlantic Athletics, will air episode 13 of season 11 this week on Thursday, Nov. 12. Every 30-minute show this season will air on The Spot stations in the South Florida market.

items.title: University Press staff predict a big-time FAU victory against Tulsa
items.summary: Flashing lights, big plays, and loud fans were all at the Flagler Credit Union Stadium last week for Florida Atlantic. Last week was electric for FAU football (6-3, 3-2 AC), a 60-29 win on ESPN. It doesn’t get much better than that in terms of excitement, but FAU cannot relish the excitement for too long,...

items.title: Game Notes #10
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football is back to its usual Saturday slate and will be on the road this week facing Tulsa on Nov. 14. Kickoff is at 3:30 p.m. ET on ESPN+ and on Fox Sports South Florida 640 AM.

items.title: Messer Named Semifinalist for Burlsworth Trophy
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – With a remarkable 2026 season in hand, Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer was announced as one of 10 semifinalists for the Burlsworth Trophy, denoting the nation's best walk-on player, on Tuesday afternoon. Messer is the only player among the 10 who resides in a G6 program.

items.title: Veltkamp Part of Davey O’Brien Class of ‘26
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's graduate QB Caden Veltkamp has been selected to the Davey O'Brien QB Class of 2026, making him a candidate for the yearly award given to the nation's best signal caller, announced on Tuesday.

items.title: Weekly Coaches Show Returns to Thursday
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. - The Florida Atlantic Coaches Show, presented by Duffy's Sports Grill, will return to Thursday this week from 6 to 7 p.m. at the Duffy's Sports Grill on St. Andrew's Boulevard in Boca Raton.

items.title: Messer Named to Paul Hornung Honor Roll
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Another masterclass showing of versatility earned Florida Atlantic football's fifth-year WR Easton Messer a spot on the Paul Hornung Award Honor Roll for Week 10, announced on Tuesday.

items.summary: Over 600 hopeful students arrived at Florida Atlantic’s Boca Raton campus excited to meet NBA Hall of Famer Shaquille O’Neal, and eager for a chance at winning just part of the total $25,000 awarded towards tuition at the Credit One Bank’s Credit Tip Off College Tour.  It’s been two years since O’Neal visited paradise, the...

items.title: Free tampons, food, and digital OWL cards: Inside FAU’s latest House meeting
items.summary: Free menstrual products, digital OWL cards, and student food insecurity were among the topics discussed at the Boca House of Representatives meeting Friday afternoon, where representatives unanimously approved a $5,290.84 catering bill for the upcoming Entertaining Democracy Conference at FAU.  The House passed BRHB 2026-71, the Entertaining Democracy Conference Catering Bill, in a 21-0 vote....

items.title: Kittley Named Coach of the Week by CBS Sports
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – After a 60-point performance against first-place RV UTSA to secure Bowl eligibility, Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley was selected by CBS Sports as the American Conference Coach of the Week.

items.title: Weekly ESPN+ Presser Features Coach Kittley, Batiste and Jones
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be joined by senior EDGE Deshaun Batiste and junior OL Aiden Jones for the weekly football press conference, which returns to Tuesday and will begin at 12 p.m., airing live on ESPN+.

items.title: Florida Atlantic to Host South Florida on ESPN+
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football will host American Conference and in-state foe South Florida on Saturday, Nov. 21, with the league announcing on Monday a 2:30 p.m. kickoff on ESPN+.

items.title: Veltkamp Earns Spot on Davey O’Brien Great 8
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's graduate QB Caden Veltkamp has been selected as a member of the Davey O'Brien Great 8 for the second time this season, announced on Monday afternoon. The weekly honor goes to the top eight quarterback performances, with one being named the National QB of the Week on Tuesday.
